versions.changelog:
Initial release of launch-codex-unpacked skill.

- Provides a script to launch Codex Desktop builds from extracted `app.asar` with debug options.
- Supports enabling or disabling inspect and remote debugging ports.
- Allows launch with a chosen SSH host for autostart and SSH-related setup.
- Offers options to use custom app paths, preserve extracted temporary files, and specify Chromium user data directories.
- Auto-installs required tooling (node/npx) via Homebrew unless disabled.
- Includes troubleshooting guidance for common issues.
